title: Concave Lens And Applications
definition: A concave lens is a diverging lens thinner at its center than at its edges, causing parallel light rays to refract outward and diverge away from a common virtual focal point.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims General Science under optics, covering image formation, ray diagrams, sign conventions, and medical applications like correcting myopia (nearsightedness).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Concave Lens And Applications.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
